text: おまえたちに　たのみが　あるんじゃ

structure.jp: たのみが　あるんじゃ
structure.en: I have a favor to ask, you see

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb gives the feeling of explaining, like adding 'you see'. Here it is んじゃ, the old-man form. たのみがあるんじゃ = 'I have a favor to ask, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜がある
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by がある says that someone has it. たのみがある = 'I have a request'.
